Rahul Gandhi Launches Digital Platform for Citizen Satyagraha Stories

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has launched a new digital initiative titled 'Share Your Satyagraha Story'. This platform aims to collect and showcase citizen-led protests and satyagraha movements across India through a digital map. The initiative seeks to document and highlight various forms of citizen activism.
